sentences.text: Hon'Ble U.C.Dhyani vs Unknown on 17 September, 2014

Author: U.C.Dhyani
Bench: U.C.Dhyani
Wpcrl No. 1118 of 2014
Hon'ble U.C.Dhyani, J.
Mr. Arvind Vashisth, Senior Advocate, assisted by Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate, present for the writ
petitioner.

Mr. Avtar Singh Rawat, Additional Advocate General, Mr. V.K.Gemini, Deputy Advocate General
and Mr. J. K. Bhatia, Standing Counsel, present for the State.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents brought on record.

The principal submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal has not been constituted in the State as yet and therefore, the petitioners cannot challenge the impugned order of the adjudicating Officer before the said Tribunal.
This Court was taken through the provisions of Sections 46(4), 68, 70, 71(6), 22 and 24 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court was also taken through the provisions of the Rules 3.1.1.8, 3.1.1.9 and 3.1.1.12 of the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.
The Court is informed by learned Additional Advocate General that Food Safety Appellate Tribunal is in the offing and shall be constituted very soon.

It is, accordingly, provided that the impugned order passed by the adjudicating officer, shall be kept in abeyance till 27.10.2014.
List this petition on 27.10.2014 as item no. 2 in the daily cause list.
